name: Lithion 4

origin.basis: French tire maker; Michelin's UK site lists its bicycle range and dealers.

manufacturing.basis: Michelin's size list does not state where these tires are made.

hookless_note: Michelin lists every size of this tube-type tire for hooked rims only.
weight_basis: Michelin's size list shows no weights; no maker weight was found.
pressure_note: Michelin's size list gives no maximum pressure; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Sold by Michelin's official Tmall store in mainland China; listed on Michelin's UK site with a dealer locator; North American availability not verified in this pass.

price_observations.market: Michelin official Tmall store (米其林官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 204.08.
